output.reason: The change text (computed diff of [ev-8998581760b8] v0.37.8 → [ev-451bd6a12e72] v1.0.0) says existing EC2NodeClass objects stay stored as v1beta1 until rewritten, and that status.storedVersions must be updated. So the exposed state is a CRD whose storedVersions still lists v1beta1. That state does not depend on which apiVersion the manifests use. gvk-in-use v1beta1 is both too broad and too narrow: it flags environments that already migrated, and it misses clusters whose manifests use v1 but still hold objects stored as v1beta1. The canonical CRD-migration shape on status.storedVersions[] expresses this exactly.

correction.statement: Storage version of ec2nodeclasses.karpenter.k8s.aws changes v1beta1 → v1. Clusters whose CRD status.storedVersions still lists v1beta1 must run a storage version migration and update storedVersions before a later release removes v1beta1.
